wording_suggested: Grew, Stetson, Storrs expose soul myth
quote: Mid-1800’s — Henry Grew, George Stetson, and George Storrs scrutinize and expose the falseness of the doctrine of the immortality of the human soul
note: No jw.org page prints 1835–1845. kr prints “Mid-1800’s” (Tamil kr: சுமார் 1850). Dated steps (w00 10/15, w23.05): Grew pamphlet c. 1835; Storrs finds it 1837; resigns 1840; lectures spring 1842.

quote: Charles T. Russell begins a careful examination of the doctrines of Christendom’s churches and finds misinterpretations of the Scriptures
note: Same kr entry adds his “wavering faith” reestablished after a sermon by Jonas Wendell. Proclaimers ch. 5 dates the Wendell evening to 1869.

quote: An article by C. T. Russell, published in the Bible Examiner, points to 1914 as the end of the Gentile Times
note: jv: “This article was printed in the October 1876 issue of the Bible Examiner.”

quote: The second event was the death of Brother Russell on October 31, 1916.
note: Aged 64, on a train at Pampa, Texas (jv).

quote: “Birth of the Nation”—that was the title of a dramatic article appearing in the March 1, 1925, issue of The Watch Tower.
N. H. Knorr becomes third president of Society on January 13

item_as_shown: Oct 2000 Governing Body separated from the legal corporations
quote: certain members of the Governing Body … voluntarily stepped aside from the boards of directors of all the corporations
note: Wording: jw.org says GB members “stepped aside from the boards of directors” (announced at the annual meeting). The GB was first “no longer identified with the board of directors” in 1971 (kr; b9-0092). Tamil page exists.

quote: The initial broadcast was aired on February 24, 1924.
note: Station on Staten Island; operated 1924 to 1957 (b12-0079).

date_as_printed: In the 1930’s and into the 1940’s (kr); 1934 portable phonographs (jv)
quote: In the 1930’s and into the 1940’s, publishers used recorded Bible lectures played on portable phonographs.
note: jv: “In 1934 the Society began producing portable phonographs.” Doorstep use introduced 1937.

date_as_printed: April 17-18, 1943 (booklet Course in Theocratic Ministry released)
quote: held throughout the United States on April 17 and 18, 1943, the booklet Course in Theocratic Ministry was released.
note: Called “Course in Theocratic Ministry (now called Theocratic Ministry School)” in jv. The course started at headquarters Feb 16, 1942 (b8-0239).

quote: the first of those books was the Theocratic Aid to Kingdom Publishers, released in 1945.
note: Full title: Theocratic Aid to Kingdom Publishers.

quote: in 1979 a group of Jehovah’s Witnesses … began to design and build the Multilanguage Electronic Phototypesetting System (MEPS).
note: Printed as plain 1979 (not “c.”); 1979 is when development began. By May 1986 it handled 186 languages.

quote: At the “Kingdom Increase” District Conventions of Jehovah’s Witnesses, held in 1984, a revised reference edition was issued in English.
note: Title: New World Translation of the Holy Scriptures—With References.

quote: two new brochures were released, Listen to God and Live Forever and a simplified version, Listen to God.
note: Two brochures, not one. Approved for 431 languages on release. Tamil page exists.

quote: October 2013—App released containing the revised New World Translation
note: Released at the annual meeting; not “c.”. JW Library Sign Language app also 2013 (b20-0016). Tamil page exists.

quote: ON October 6, 2014, a trial arrangement for an English-language Internet television station called JW Broadcasting was launched.
The study edition of the book of Matthew was published in English in October 2015.
note: Only Matthew, English; other books added progressively. No WOL/Tamil statement found.

quote: JW.ORG now has articles, videos, and audio content available in 1,000 languages, including 100 sign languages.
note: Includes 100 sign languages; 508 languages in January 2013.

date_as_printed: March 2020 (news reports of Mar. 3 and Mar. 26, 2020)
quote: Instead of engaging in public witnessing or going to people’s homes, they have shared their message largely by telephone and letters.
note: jw.org gives no single worldwide suspension date; mark as month-level (about).

quote: Jehovah’s Witnesses around the world resumed their hallmark house-to-house ministry on September 1, 2022.
note: “Public ministry” is ambiguous: public (cart) witnessing resumed earlier (b9-0408); September 1, 2022 is house-to-house.

quote: the New World Translation of the Holy Scriptures is now available in whole or in part in 350 languages.
note: Reached with Kwanyama (complete) and Ndonga (Greek Scriptures), Windhoek, Namibia.
